notes.title: Hyposphere VR was released for Oculus Rift.
notes.content:
Today we released Hyposphere VR for Oculus Rift in the Oculus Store. Yhis release have new ball physics and many great improvements.
Here is the link to Oculus Store. https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1431078190308607/
Soon update (non VR) will be released in Steam!
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Hyposphere Update v.1.3.16
notes.content:
- Now you got limited control of the camera (with mouse / right stick)
- Fallen blocks now restored correctly
- Now you could use left shift to enter "sneaking" mode and move slowly - use it for controls accuracy
- Restart button at the end of the level
- Now you could adjust FOV (field of view) in settings
- Main menu buttons / logos tweaks

notes.title: Thanks to community!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

We want to say big "Thank you!" for yours support and lot of game experience reports. We're still polishing the game and you'll see couple of interesting updates in next days! Stay tuned ːlegitimacyː

If you found some bugs in current version - please report them into "Bug reports" thread here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/461880/discussions/0/364040166685270272/

Also if you have got VR hardware and you could test VR-mode in Hyposphere - please write about it here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/461880/discussions/0/364040797995450400/

Good luck from Hyposphere team! ːnecroheartː
